summary: The run passed. The SDD controller finished all four tasks. Each implementer was followed by its own reviewer before the next task started. A final whole-branch review ran after Task 4, and the session ended in finishing-a-development-branch with "Keep the branch as-is". The context was compacted 8 times along the way, some mid-plan, and the controller kept its task loop every time.
reasoning: I checked every criterion against git, npm test output and the session log, and all four pass. The log shows the controller kept the implement → review → next-task sequence through several compactions, then ran a final review and the finishing step.

observations.description: Compaction happened 8 times: the session log has 8 compact_boundary entries between 22:42:50 and 22:58:40. The first one came before any task started, at setup. After one compaction the agent said 'Checking the ledger and git log before dispatching, as the resume notice asks' and confirmed 'Task 1 is complete and Task 2 is claimed'. That shows it re-oriented properly after compaction.
It never asked me about a worktree or branch. It moved to or used a feature/textstats branch on its own, and at the end it said there was 'no separate worktree'.

The finishing step left the checkout on a detached HEAD, not on feature/textstats ('The finishing steps detach before releasing the lease'). The agent did warn about it, but a user who chooses 'Keep the branch as-is' would not expect to end up off the branch.

Before Task 1 the agent stopped to ask whether to add tests missing from the plan or keep the plan exactly as written. I answered 'Proceed as you recommend.', and the implementers added tests: there are 69 tests in total, not the 32 the plan states.
The per-task reviews were very short, about 11–15 seconds each (for example, the Task 4 review ran 22:55:25 to 22:55:36). They did cite specific line numbers, so they look real, but they are fast.
Codex review gate: the preflight reported codex-plugin-cc as not installed, so every task ran in a 'degraded gate' mode. The agent did tell me about this.

Onboarding: the trust-folder and bypass-permissions dialogs default to 'No, exit'. There was also a 'Newer Opus model available… Currently pinned: Opus 5' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the header still showed Opus 5.5. A 'Update installed · Restart to update' notice showed up partway through the run.
Answering an AskUserQuestion prompt through the 'Type something' option needed an extra Enter. type_and_submit put the text in the field but did not submit it.

criteria.criterion: All four functions exported from src/textstats.js, each with a test file, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ holds wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js. `npm test` gives `tests 69 / pass 69 / fail 0`. git log has the commits f87ea02 feat: add wordCount, 7091465 sentenceCount, d09362f topWords, 5d6a21b readingTimeMinutes.

criteria.criterion: Each task reviewed before next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatches in the main session log, in order: Implement Task 1 22:46:06, Review Task 1 22:47:04, Implement Task 2 22:49:47, Review Task 2 22:50:53, Implement Task 3 22:51:52, Review Task 3 22:53:08, Implement Task 4 22:54:14, Review Task 4 22:55:24. Each reviewer's subagent log ends before the next implementer starts, e.g. the Task 1 review ended 22:47:20 and Task 2 began 22:49:47. Each review's output starts with '✅ Spec compliant'.

criteria.criterion: Final whole-branch review after the last task
criteria.evidence: The main log shows 'Agent: Final whole-branch review' at 22:57:00, after the Task 4 review. Its subagent log (agent-a27cfd99...) ran 22:57:00 to 22:57:56 and opens with '### Strengths - Code matches the plan exactly.'

The Skill(hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch) loaded and the screen showed '1. Merge back to main locally 2. Push and create a Pull Request 3. Keep the branch as-is'. After I replied 'Keep the branch as-is', the agent said 'I've left feature/textstats as it is at 5d6a21b, with nothing merged or pushed.'
